title: Secondary text below WCAG AA contrast in both themes (--ink3)
evidence: sweep lowc: 3.51:1 dark, 3.08:1 light (needs 4.5); browser_audit B-002
user_impact: Hard to read, especially outdoors on phones
fix: --ink3 #8E8E88 (dark) / #6A6862 (light); light status colours darkened

title: 9 text elements below WCAG contrast
fix: Darken text or change background to reach 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text).

title: Side-by-side demo (#/live) overflows the screen at 320px
evidence: baseline sweep: phone/pcol right edge beyond 320px viewport; screenshot baseline-dark-320-live.png
user_impact: Phone frame cut off on small phones
fix: Grid column minmax(0,1fr); pcol width 100% max 372px

title: Home hero CTA labels break into 2-3 lines on 320-375px
user_impact: Main call to action hard to read
fix: Stack CTAs full width under 440px, nowrap

title: Pricing "Book" buttons collapse to ~23px height on mobile
user_impact: Buttons look broken, hard to tap
fix: .lp-plan .lp-btn{flex:none}

title: Dark/light toggle hidden on mobile header (<=560px)
user_impact: Mobile users cannot change theme from the header
fix: Theme button always visible; 3-way Light/Dark/Auto in menu and in app settings

title: Small text-only tap targets (try links, "All", "Change", "Edit", footer links ~20-22px)
location: home, app home, report compose, payment
fix: Padding to >=40px hit area

title: Governorate selects without accessible name
fix: aria-label added

title: "For business" eyebrow 2.9:1 on black panel in light mode
fix: Fixed yellow on black

title: 13 touch targets under 24px on mobile
evidence: a.try "جرّب التسجيل" 96x22; a.try "جرّب التفعيل" 90x22; a.try "جرّب كمُبلِّغ" 81x22; a.try "جرّب الرد" 68x22; a.lp-btn "احجز" 238x23; a "صفحة المُبلِّغ" 130x22

title: Control does nothing when clicked
fix: Implement it, or mark it as unavailable/prototype. No fake functionality.

title: No <h1> on page
